userStories.title: GitHub HTTP client, errors and rate limits
userStories.description: As a developer I need one robust client for GitHub GraphQL and REST so failures are classified consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/github/client.ts: createGitHubClient({ token, apiUrl, fetch? }) with graphql<T>(query, variables) and rest<T>(method, path, body?)
Sends Authorization: Bearer, Accept, X-GitHub-Api-Version (REST); 20 s timeout via AbortSignal

GitHubError with kind (ErrorKind in model.ts), status, message, resetAt, retryAfterSeconds; GraphQL `errors` arrays map to graphql/not_found/forbidden kinds; 401 -> unauthorized; 403/429 with x-ratelimit-remaining: 0 or retry-after -> rate_limited; secondary rate limits handled; 5xx -> server; fetch failure/abort -> network
parseRateLimit from headers and from the GraphQL rateLimit object
The token never appears in error messages, causes or toString() output (tested)
Coverage >= 95% for src/lib/github
`pnpm verify` passes (lint, types, coverage gates, build, size budget, E2E)
userStories.notes: client.ts (graphql with opt-in partial, rest), errors.ts (GitHubError, status and GraphQL type classification), rateLimit.ts (parseRateLimit); 100% coverage; no cause on network errors, token masked in server messages; restResponse (headers, e.g. x-oauth-scopes) is left to US-011.

userStories.title: Diff engine: detect what changed between polls
userStories.description: As a user I want to be told exactly what changed: CI failed, CI passed after failure, new review, approved, changes requested, new comment, ready to merge, merged/closed by someone else.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/diff/diffSnapshots.ts: diffSnapshots(prev | null, next, viewerLogin) -> PrEvent[] (types in model.ts); prev null -> []
ci_failed on transition to failure (also after a new head commit); ci_passed only when the previous state was failure
review_new/approved/changes_requested per new review id by someone other than the viewer
comment_new when commentCount increases and the last comment author is not the viewer
ready_to_merge on transition into ready (not draft, mergeStateStatus clean, or approved/no review required + checks success/none + mergeable)
merged/closed only when the actor is not the viewer; PRs that simply left the search scope produce nothing
Event ids are deterministic (dedupe across repeated polls); events sorted by time
Table-driven unit tests; coverage >= 95% for src/lib/diff
`pnpm verify` passes (lint, types, coverage gates, build, size budget, E2E)
userStories.notes: diffSnapshots + isReadyToMerge in src/lib/diff (100% coverage, 51 table-driven tests); ci_passed is literal (previous poll failure), so failure -> pending -> success needs the poller to pass the last settled check state (docs/architecture.md Diff engine).

userStories.title: Background poller with alarms, backoff and rate-limit awareness
userStories.description: As a user I want Prowl to stay up to date in the background without burning my GitHub rate limit.
acceptanceCriteria: src/background/poller.ts: schedules alarm `poll` every settings.pollIntervalMinutes (min 1, default 2); reschedules when settings change; runs on install/startup when signed in
Single-flight: concurrent triggers share one in-flight poll
Exponential backoff with jitter on errors (interval x 2^n, max 30 min); rate_limited or remaining < 100 waits until resetAt; unauthorized stops polling and surfaces the error
Persists snapshot + pollState (model.ts) and prunes local state for PRs that no longer exist
src/background/messages.ts routes BackgroundRequest messages ({type:'poll', force}, markSeen, signedOut)
src/lib/time/backoff.ts pure + tested; poller unit tests use fake timers and the chrome fake
E2E: with auth seeded through the service worker, a forced poll fetches from the mock and stores a snapshot; tests/e2e/fixtures.ts gains signIn() and poll() helpers
`pnpm verify` passes (lint, types, coverage gates, build, size budget, E2E)

Clicking a notification opens the PR (only URLs under env.webUrl) and clears it; ids map to URLs via chrome.storage.session
Unit tests for every filter rule and message template
E2E: a mock scenario change (CI pending -> failure) produces a notification visible via chrome.notifications.getAll() in the worker; a muted PR produces none
